root_cause: The merged Instagram/social publication migrations were deployed to Supabase after merge through the migration API, which registered production versions different from the pre-deploy repository timestamps. Terminal closure correctly rejected the mismatch.
prevention_rule: Repository migration filenames must be reconciled to the exact versions recorded by the production Supabase migration ledger whenever the production migration authority assigns canonical versions. Terminal evidence remains fail-closed on version/name mismatch.
